I didn't expect my comment to be copied verbatim 😅 
```suggestion
				Returns [code]true[/code] if this string is a valid file name. A valid file name cannot be empty, begin or end with space characters, or contain characters that are not allowed ([code]:[/code] [code]/[/code] [code]\[/code] [code]?[/code] [code]*[/code] [code]"[/code] [code]|[/code] [code]%[/code] [code]<[/code] [code]>[/code]).
```
or
```suggestion
				Returns [code]true[/code] if this string is not empty, does not begin or end with space characters, and does not contain characters that are not allowed in file names ([code]:[/code] [code]/[/code] [code]\[/code] [code]?[/code] [code]*[/code] [code]"[/code] [code]|[/code] [code]%[/code] [code]<[/code] [code]>[/code]).
```
or similar.
Also applies to StringName's equivalent.
